task.title: Clarify the first-run workspace setup
task.summary: Replace the ambiguous setup handoff with a short, reversible owner flow.
task.outcome: A new owner can create a local workspace, understand what will happen, and safely cancel before any repository write.

task.criterionTwo: Cancel returns to Portfolio without writing configuration.
task.criterionThree: Phone, tablet, and desktop preserve the same reading order.
task.diagnosticsSummary: Prompts, raw run status, and worker payloads are restricted to this disclosure.
